subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Which public sub-agent completion-announcement control should OpenClaw support for deterministic suppression: per-spawn only, config default, or a unified announce policy that can also compose with parent routing and per-channel suppression?
rationale: The missing behavior is proven in source, but choosing a new tool/config contract changes compatibility-sensitive public surface and overlaps several open routing/suppression requests.

options.title: Adopt Unified Announce Policy
options.body: Add an additive policy that defaults to current behavior, supports deterministic skip, and leaves room for parent/per-channel routing without parallel controls.

options.title: Add Per-Spawn Skip Only
options.body: Expose a smaller `sessions_spawn` override first and defer global or channel defaults until a broader routing design is selected.

options.title: Defer To Routing Design
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide broader `announceTarget` and per-channel suppression semantics before adding public surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt Unified Announce Policy
recommendation.body: Add an additive policy that defaults to current behavior, supports deterministic skip, and leaves room for parent/per-channel routing without parallel controls.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for the spawn/announce public API and the compatibility-sensitive config/tool decision.
